mutationCheck: F-B1-001 negative case was confirmed to fail (exit non-zero) when the old key format was temporarily restored, then the fix was restored.
notRun: scripts/run-validation.mjs and the whole vitest suite were intentionally not run; the reviewer runs them independently.
deviations: Missing or wrong control token returns the existing 403 FORBIDDEN (unchanged token hook), not 401.
Idempotent replay with the same payload returns HTTP 200 (first creation stays 201) and the control audit event WORKOS_IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY replaces WORKOS_*_CREATED.

Cockpit interpretation: projects/missions are UNAVAILABLE (null counts) while the Work OS journal does not exist yet, ERROR on tamper or unavailable store; awaitingApproval lists missions in PREFLIGHT or FOUNDER_ATTENTION_REQUIRED; orchestrator is STALE when the state has no valid updatedAt or its lease has expired, ERROR on corrupt/invalid state or a transition log that does not verify, and VERIFIED otherwise; workforce.state stays UNAVAILABLE (ERROR on a malformed registry) because activeWorkerRuns is null until the mission runner (B3) exists, while registeredRoles/targetRoles are still reported when readable.
orchestrator-state.mjs has no .d.mts and automation/lib is protected; server.ts imports it with a documented @ts-expect-error and a narrow local cast (read-only use: loadState, verifyTransitionLog).
buildServer gained an optional repoRoot option (default process.cwd(), unchanged behaviour) so cockpit tests can use an empty temp repo.
